svg.text: Raw material AS/RS (ASRS-RAW) – rack plan, front elevation and cross-section with dimensions (example design, mm unless marked)

Load: crate 1 200 × 800 × 600 mm (guide 10), max 300 kg, stored with the 800 mm side to the aisle, 2 crates per bay, single-deep, both sides of one crane aisle. Clearances 75 mm (check FEM 9.831 / EN 15620 with the supplier).
